method.method_summary: Targeted retrieval of public government and public-institution pages, followed by claim-level extraction and prohibited-inference review.
method.cache_note: Retrieval cache is kept outside the submission; sources.json records exact cache-byte digests for reproducibility.
method.evidence_boundary: Records below are published facts or published programme statements. They are not field observations, precise geometry, approvals, commitments or operating results.

observations.spatial_scope: Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park Phase II and the publicly described nine-kilometre corridor
observations.published_claim_summary: The cited public report states that Phase II opened and describes a continuous green corridor from Xizhimen to the North Fifth Ring.
observations.design_consequence: Treat the open park and basic green continuity as a reported baseline. Proposed AI and programme elements must demonstrate incremental public value and avoid presenting the green spine as an unbuilt proposal achievement.
observations.field_verification_required: Complete a post-opening walk-through and operator interview to record actual continuity, access hours, active works, closures and maintenance conditions before fixing any pilot location.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not infer an as-built alignment, permanent availability, complete accessibility, precise length, statutory boundary or approval for any new intervention.

observations.temporal_scope: conditions and works described at opening
observations.published_claim_summary: The report describes a 23.08-hectare southern segment serving a context of 70 communities and about 450,000 residents, wall removal, an accessible Three-Ring Gateway treatment and nine opened side-road links.
observations.design_consequence: Prioritise residents, everyday commuters and non-AI wayfinding at Dazhongsi and southern gateways. New displays or events should not duplicate basic recreation or narrow the reported public connections.
observations.field_verification_required: Count and map usable crossings, step-free routes, desire lines, peak-hour conflicts, quiet-time needs and the actual catchment through an accessible co-walk; verify all published counts with the current operator before reuse.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not treat media-reported areas, population or link counts as survey-grade metrics, current census totals, cadastral facts or evidence that every link is barrier-free.

observations.spatial_scope: publicly described northern natural-leisure segment and adjacent slow-travel connections
observations.temporal_scope: conditions and works described at opening
observations.published_claim_summary: The report describes a 2.6-kilometre, 30.01-hectare northern segment, three fishbone slow paths and links to the Qinghe waterfront, Dongsheng Bajia Park and the Huilongguan bicycle route.
observations.design_consequence: Use the northern segment as a low-intrusion verification corridor: protect quiet and ecological functions, place sensing only where a clearly defined public task cannot be met by simpler means, and preserve an offline route.
observations.field_verification_required: Verify route continuity, habitat sensitivity, lighting, conflicts among walking, running and cycling, weather exposure and places where no additional equipment is appropriate.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not infer ecological capacity, engineering feasibility, exact route geometry, unrestricted cycling access or permission to install sensors.

observations.spatial_scope: publicly described park facilities and railway-heritage reuse
observations.temporal_scope: Phase I background and Phase II opening report
observations.published_claim_summary: The sources describe all-age recreation, sports, rest, sponge-city measures and reused railway heritage as existing park functions or design features.
observations.design_consequence: Begin with a use-and-gap audit instead of adding a parallel attraction layer. Each physical prototype must name the existing facility it supports, its no-build alternative and its removal state.
observations.field_verification_required: Inventory actual amenities, accessible routes, drainage performance indicators, heritage elements, occupancy patterns and operator constraints with dates and photographs cleared for internal review.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not claim audited facility condition, heritage authenticity, hydraulic performance, user satisfaction or a right to alter existing assets.

observations.spatial_scope: Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt programme context
observations.temporal_scope: midterm planning priorities reported in July 2026
observations.published_claim_summary: The report calls for a forward-looking human-machine coexistence experimental field, flexible space for AI uncertainty, AI for Science, AI safety governance and participation in international rules.
observations.design_consequence: Use reversible space and evidence gates as the physical expression of uncertainty. At Zhongzhiyuan, pair AI4S demonstrations with safety, failure publication and independent retest rather than technology display alone.
observations.field_verification_required: Confirm the current programme brief, responsible reviewing bodies, applicable safety regimes and spaces legally available for controlled tests before advancing beyond G0.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not infer a legal sandbox, waived regulation, approved test site, international mandate or committed reviewing institution.

observations.spatial_scope: Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt programme context
observations.temporal_scope: midterm planning priorities reported in July 2026
observations.published_claim_summary: The report identifies top research talent, young innovators and entrepreneurs, and permanent residents; it also calls for a five-minute life circle, visible and experiential AI, and responses to transport and institutional barriers.
observations.design_consequence: Nest five-minute daily-support cells inside the broader fifteen-minute public-service network and test all three published target groups alongside the proposal's seven personas. Visibility must mean understandable public benefit, not mandatory screen exposure.
observations.field_verification_required: Recruit a documented and consented cross-section of local users; map time-based access to daily services and barriers; test both AI and non-AI task completion without collecting unnecessary identity data.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not infer the three groups are homogeneous, that any named institution participates, that a five-minute target is currently achieved, or that AI is the preferred solution.

observations.spatial_scope: AI Origin Community and related Haidian AI programme context
observations.temporal_scope: ecosystem and programme description published in July 2026
observations.published_claim_summary: The page reports a roughly three-kilometre Origin Community context, a ten-minute innovation circle and dated contextual counts for scientists, developers, AI students, enterprises and research institutions, alongside real-scene urban-governance and public-service testing.
observations.design_consequence: At Origin, connect co-creation to a bounded public task and a staffed fallback. Use ecosystem counts only to frame recruitment questions; do not use them as demand forecasts or partnership evidence.
observations.field_verification_required: Verify current programme geography, active venues, user needs, service ownership and a consented recruitment path; independently refresh any ecosystem count before quantitative reuse.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not treat published counts as a live registry, sum them as unique people, infer membership, identify individuals, promise demand or claim any organisation as a partner.

observations.spatial_scope: Haidian district policy context and Dazhongsi as a publicly named programme focus node; not parcel-level control
observations.temporal_scope: Dazhongsi focus-node direction reported on 2026-07-28, combined with district-level 2026-2030 policy direction published on 2026-04-28
observations.published_claim_summary: The midterm report names Dazhongsi as an important area for distinctive nodes and urban scenarios, while the district plan sets broader AI-highland, high-quality urban-renewal and public-service directions. Neither captured source establishes a specific Dazhongsi parcel action.
observations.design_consequence: Frame Dazhongsi as a candidate public-service and existing-space transition interface, reuse current services first, and avoid assigning a named parcel or tenant before field and authority confirmation.
observations.field_verification_required: Obtain current ownership, tenancy, approved planning, access, fire, transport and municipal conditions, then verify whether any site-specific action is justified before preparing it.
observations.prohibited_inference: Do not infer parcel control, demolition, vacancy, tenant consent, funding, programme approval, development intensity or delivery commitment.

scenario_grounding.name: Low-speed delivery safety sandbox
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: controlled-test interface near the northern verification area; exact site unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The published northern park context combines walking, running and cycling with an AI-safety programme ambition, creating a question about whether low-speed systems can be tested without transferring risk to everyday users.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A bounded shadow or closed-course test can expose perception, geofence and takeover failure modes that a static design review cannot reproduce.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: Manual delivery and an unobstructed signed route remain the default service and public path.
g1_field_checks: verify a legal closed-course site separated from ordinary park movement
map walking, running, cycling, ecology and operator conflicts
drill physical emergency stop, boundary breach and human takeover
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if separation from the public cannot be guaranteed, a physical stop fails, a geofence breach occurs or the manual service and public route cannot remain available.

scenario_grounding.name: Public-space energy assistant
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: existing park operations interface with ecological and quiet-time constraints; exact site unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The opened park is reported to include all-age, ecological and sponge-city functions, so energy management must preserve minimum safety, accessibility and quiet conditions rather than optimise consumption alone.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A constrained controller may compare ambient and device conditions across operating modes, but only if it demonstrates improvement over a manual schedule without reducing safety lighting.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: A published manual operating schedule, minimum safety-lighting standard and physical override remain authoritative.
g1_field_checks: meter a dated manual baseline without identifying visitors
verify minimum lighting, accessible controls and quiet hours
test manual override and restoration under sensor or network failure
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if metering lacks authority, savings cannot be compared with a manual baseline, safety lighting is reduced or a physical override is unavailable.

scenario_grounding.name: Safety-incident decision support
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: staffed verification-room interface; not an automated public-space enforcement zone
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The published AI-safety ambition creates an opportunity to test auditable human review of authorised event logs before any operational recommendation is used.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: Offline comparison may reveal inconsistent triage or missed patterns, while leaving every public action and enforcement decision with an authorised person.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: Existing staffed incident intake, emergency services and manual decision procedures remain the sole operational path.
g1_field_checks: confirm lawful incident-log purpose, retention and access
run retrospective or synthetic shadow cases without public action
test explanation, disagreement, correction and deletion routes
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if it identifies people without authority, automates enforcement, delays emergency response or produces an action that is not independently reviewed by a named human.

scenario_grounding.name: Failure and correction public archive
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: online-first and staffed public-review interface linked to the verification area; exact display site unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: A visible AI-safety programme needs public evidence of failure, correction and retirement, while protecting people affected by incidents.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: Structured comparison can connect model, protocol and corrective-action versions; automated drafting may assist redaction checks but cannot decide publication.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: A human-curated versioned register, right of reply and correction channel can operate without AI.
g1_field_checks: test redaction against representative failure records
verify right of reply, factual dispute and withdrawal handling
confirm accessible online, print and staffed access
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if personal data may be exposed, a factual dispute lacks a hold process, publication can be retaliatory or the archive cannot work through human curation alone.

scenario_grounding.name: Trustworthy Jing-Zhang cultural guide
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: existing railway-heritage and Origin-community interpretation interface; exact asset and site unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The park is reported to reuse railway heritage and the Origin programme seeks perceptible AI, creating a need for multilingual interpretation that does not turn generated content into historical evidence.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A source-bounded assistant may adapt cleared interpretation by language and accessibility need while exposing citations and uncertainty.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: Curator-approved static signs, printed text, tactile or audio alternatives and a staffed correction route remain available.
g1_field_checks: inventory the exact heritage asset and approved interpretation
verify every claim, right and generated-content label
co-test comprehension, correction and non-screen alternatives
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if provenance is missing, a disputed claim is presented as fact, generated content is misleading or an accessible non-AI interpretation is absent.

scenario_grounding.name: Open-source collaboration matching
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: opt-in Origin-community co-creation session; no permanent matching zone or partner venue confirmed
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The published innovation ecosystem and three target groups create potential for issue-based collaboration, but participation must not become an employment, eligibility or reputation score.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A transparent suggestion tool may surface compatible voluntary skills, issues and licence preferences across a large opt-in pool.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: A public issue board, facilitated workshop and self-selected sign-up remain the equal participation route.
g1_field_checks: verify a real venue, problem owner and consented participant cohort
compare matching with self-selection and facilitator allocation
test withdrawal, non-discrimination and licence preference handling
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if matching influences employment or benefits, withdrawal is blocked, protected characteristics drive ranking or the same collaboration cannot be joined without AI.

scenario_grounding.name: Educational experience workshop
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: supervised Origin-community learning room or temporary workshop; venue unconfirmed
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The published concentration of students and goal of experiential AI support a supervised literacy workshop, provided participation is not limited to technical users or dependent on personal data export.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A local sandbox can make model limits, provenance and correction tangible through bounded exercises under teacher control.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: Teacher-led demonstrations, printed exercises and offline group discussion provide the same learning objective.
g1_field_checks: confirm school, guardian, safeguarding and venue requirements
test local data isolation and teacher override
compare learning and inclusion with the non-AI lesson
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if minors can use it unsupervised, data leave the approved sandbox, harmful output lacks immediate human control or offline participation is inferior.

scenario_grounding.name: Climate and accessibility co-test
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: existing park route and rest-facility co-test circuit; exact circuit unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: Reported all-age and sponge-city facilities create a testable question about whether weather, shade, rest and barriers provide equal task completion under real daily conditions.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A minimised assistant may combine current weather and verified barrier reports to prompt a safer route, but only after the physical route works without it.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: A surveyed step-free route, shelters, drinking and rest information, static warnings and on-site staff remain authoritative.
g1_field_checks: survey route, shade, rest, drainage and temporary barriers
run consented multi-group tasks in safe weather windows
compare AI advice with static information and staff guidance
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy in unsafe weather, where the accessible route is blocked, where group outcome gaps materially worsen or where static and staffed guidance are unavailable.

scenario_grounding.name: Accessible route assistant
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: Dazhongsi and southern-gateway public-service route interface; exact route unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: Published wall removal and opened links create a post-opening need to verify whether everyday step-free journeys actually connect transport, park and public services.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A source-timestamped assistant may relay temporary barriers and facility status faster than a static map after a verified route baseline exists.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: A surveyed step-free route, static accessible map, staffed confirmation and complaint route remain available at equal cost and rights.
g1_field_checks: co-walk every critical segment and confirm slopes, crossings and operating hours
verify the owner and update time of each temporary barrier or facility status
compare success, time and safety in AI, static and staffed modes
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if a critical barrier exists, status cannot be manually confirmed, a non-AI route is missing or advice creates a safety-critical misroute.

scenario_grounding.name: Slow-travel congestion notice
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: post-opening crossing or shared slow-travel segment during a bounded peak or event window; exact segment unknown
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The reported connected walking, running and cycling network may create time-specific conflicts that should be measured before any rerouting layer is proposed.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A bounded, non-identifying count model may predict short-lived crowding early enough for staff to issue a reversible notice.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: Staff observation, temporary signs, published route capacity and no-reroute operation remain the baseline.
g1_field_checks: observe dated movement conflicts without identifying people
define a no-intervention baseline and approved alternative routes
test whether advice shifts conflict or burdens accessible users
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if identification is required, an alternative route is unverified, notices worsen access or static guidance and staff control are unavailable.

scenario_grounding.name: Enterprise-service agent
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: staffed Dazhongsi existing-space service desk; venue and service owner unconfirmed
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: Published innovation-district and existing-space renewal intent suggests a need for legible service navigation, but no named site, tenant or formal service scope is confirmed.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A source-bounded assistant may help users traverse changing public information while exposing the authoritative source, date, refusal and staffed handoff.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: The official source page, printed checklist and staffed counter complete the same bounded task without AI.
g1_field_checks: confirm the service owner, venue and fixed question set
version authoritative sources and simulate stale or conflicting information
compare completion, rights, cost, time, refusal and handoff across modes
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if it gives unsupported formal advice, a stale source affects an application, human handoff fails or venue and service authority are unconfirmed.

scenario_grounding.name: Community health navigation
scenario_grounding.provisional_spatial_type: staffed southern community public-information point; provider directory and site unconfirmed
scenario_grounding.local_problem_or_opportunity: The published large residential catchment and five-minute daily-life ambition create a question about finding current services without turning public-space assistance into diagnosis or eligibility screening.
scenario_grounding.why_ai_increment: A tightly bounded assistant may translate and search a verified public provider directory while immediately redirecting emergencies and uncertain cases to people.
scenario_grounding.non_ai_baseline: A current printed or web directory, staffed information point and emergency numbers remain the authoritative route.
g1_field_checks: confirm the provider directory owner and update duty
test emergency redirection, non-diagnostic refusal and staffed handoff
compare completion among older, disabled and ordinary users in AI and non-AI modes
scenario_grounding.do_not_deploy_if: Do not deploy if it produces diagnosis, delays emergency redirection, uses stale provider information, collects unnecessary health data or lacks a staffed and printed alternative.

design_use_rule.publication_rule: Until the required field step is completed, proposal language must use reported, proposed, pending verification or unknown rather than existing-condition certification.
design_use_rule.no_build_test: Every physical or AI layer must document the existing baseline, a non-AI or no-build option, incremental public benefit, removal method and restoration owner role.

jury_reading_contract.purpose: Keep published orientation, the repository provisional design container and proposal-defined design relationships separately legible so that presentation clarity cannot be mistaken for site precision.

frames.authority: published public-source claims recorded in SG-001 through SG-008
geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson with provisional source and usage fields
proposal-defined Twin-Track, switchyard, public-rights, failure and evidence contracts
may_support: stop, handover, restoration and exit logic

jury_reading_contract.co_registration_rule: The three frames must not be overlaid, aligned or styled as one co-registered existing-condition or master-plan map until authoritative geometry, dated field evidence and qualified review are accepted for that use.

unresolved_geometry_checks.current_record: The recorded OSM background comparison reports 0 percent polygon overlap and about 412.5 metres separation; it is not an official-boundary comparison.
unresolved_geometry_checks.current_action: Keep the submitted boundary provisional and unchanged; do not visually merge the OSM background and PROV-SITE-001.
unresolved_geometry_checks.recalculation_trigger: Organizer-issued authoritative site geometry or another source explicitly accepted by maintainers for geometry replacement.

unresolved_geometry_checks.current_record: PROV-KEY-003 does not establish an exact Dazhongsi station, road, parcel or building anchor.
unresolved_geometry_checks.current_action: Keep PROV-KEY-003 provisional and unchanged; read the Dazhongsi four-way diagram as a service and movement relationship only.
unresolved_geometry_checks.recalculation_trigger: Organizer-issued key-area geometry or a maintainer-accepted anchor supported by authoritative site evidence.

package_validation_contract.evidence_boundary: These checks protect package bytes and presentation contracts. They do not validate site truth, professional acceptance, approval, accessibility compliance, operation or public performance.

public_signal_interface_round18.purpose: Keep the public signal interface attached to the three-frame site-reading method: it communicates proposal-defined relationships and truthful unknown or zero states, but does not locate a built device, staffed post, approved window or surveyed route.

readable_contract.javascript_role: optional local enhancement that reads the same static HTML table
readable_contract.javascript_disabled_reading: all 12 rows and six fields remain visible and readable

site_truth_rules.carrier: continuous observation bypass plus isolated proof edge
site_truth_rules.prohibited_inference: no existing bypass, court, equipment edge, staffed post or exact location is claimed

site_truth_rules.carrier: one daily street, two courts and four independently withdrawable nodes
site_truth_rules.prohibited_inference: no existing street/court configuration, resident consent, node position or operation is claimed

site_truth_rules.carrier: continuous four-way commuting plus an off-route hall and desk
site_truth_rules.prohibited_inference: no station, road, parcel, building, entrance, hall or desk anchor is claimed
